text: A Wi-Fi analyser shows nothing on a channel and the link still performs badly. What should you reach for?
choices: A spectrum analyser, which shows everything radiating rather than only Wi-Fi
explanation: A microwave oven appears as a broad hump on a duty cycle synchronised to mains frequency; a video sender as a constant narrow carrier; a cordless phone as frequency hopping. A Wi-Fi analyser is blind to all of them.
